terms.title: Terms
terms.intro: These terms cover the Aura website, the early beta waitlist, and the Aura app when it opens. If you join the waitlist or use the site, you agree to them.

waitlist.title: Early beta
waitlist.body: Joining the waitlist is free. You give us an email so we can tell you when Aura opens and send you your referral link. Early Aura is a promise we honour when you create an account with that same email. It is not cash, not a security, and not transferable to anyone else.

aura.title: Aura
aura.body: Aura is a score inside the product. We can reverse Aura that came from abuse, fake accounts, or broken rules. Referral Aura is awarded when a new person creates an account through your link. Joining the waitlist is not enough. You cannot refer yourself.

content.title: Your posts
content.body: When the app opens, you keep the rights to what you post. You give Aura a licence to show it in the feed, on share pages, and in rankings. Do not post anything you do not have the right to share.

conduct.title: Keep it clean
conduct.body: No spam, hate, harassment, bots, or farming rings. Break the rules and we can remove content, take Aura back, or close the account. We will not argue about it in a comment section.

privacy.title: What we keep
privacy.body: We store the email you give us, the referral link you share, and messages you send through the contact form. We do not sell that list. We use it to run the waitlist, send the emails you asked for, and later open your account. You can write us to be removed.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update these terms as the product opens. The date on this page is the one that applies. The site is provided as-is while we are still in early beta.

terms.contact: Questions: use the contact form. Aura is operated by the team behind aurarankd.com.

faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.intro: Short answers. If yours is missing, write us.

what.a: Your vibe, as a score. You post. People like it. You gain Aura. Everyone can see where you rank.

gain.a: Post something that hits. Each like gives you Aura. On the waitlist, you also get Aura for joining early and for every friend who signs up through your link.

followers.a: Nah. Just Aura. The feed is not a popularity contest you already won before you posted.

lose.a: Only if you break the rules or we have to reverse something fake. Likes you earned honestly stay.

waitlist.a: The app launches in two weeks. Join now with your email. You get +10 Aura for showing up early and a link to bring friends.

referral.q: How does the referral link work?
referral.a: Share your link. Each new person who signs up through it gives you +10 Aura. A waitlist email alone does not count. You cannot refer yourself.

port.q: Does this Aura carry into the app?
port.a: Yes. When you create your account with the same email, we move your early Aura onto it. That is the whole point of joining now.

launch.a: In two weeks. We'll email you.

age.q: How old do I have to be?
age.a: 13 or older. If you are under 18, you need a parent or guardian who is fine with you being here.

intro.title: About Aura
intro.body: Aura is a social game, and the social network is the game board. You post a photo or a video, people like it, and every like gives Aura straight to the creator. One public number, one place on the board, visible to everyone.

levels.title: Levels
levels.description: Every threshold you cross changes the title next to your name. Nothing to buy and nothing to unlock — only Aura moves you up.

ledger.title: Every point has a receipt
ledger.body: Aura is a ledger, not a counter. Each point traces back to the like that created it, so an unlike or a removed post takes its Aura with it. That is what keeps a high position worth having.

levels.title: Titles are cosmetic
levels.body: A level changes the title next to your name and nothing else. It buys no reach, no extra Aura per like and no advantage over anyone below you.

web.title: What this site is for
web.body: The web is discovery, sharing and voting: see what is trending, open any post from a link, look at the global board, and award Aura. Posting stays in the app.
